setup.reason: Frozen configuration, prompt and pre-launch source hashes match; baseline source and TASK bytes verified. Retained session matches stdout thread ID and fixture cwd, and identifies CLI 0.154.0. Complete inventory verifies capture. Guidance contains native system skills and the intended target condition, without DD or controller criteria. Complete CW text appears in a tool response before editing.

criteria.reason: The full briefing preserves current-team continuity, the four-team decision, opt-in/default distinction, all evidence and collection-size limits, the support caveat, named checks, timeout threshold/interval, conditional approval and seven-day review. Broader rollout remains a later decision.

The reader can decide on the four invitations using the same evidence and prerequisites as the source. Consent, switch-back, investigation on failed checks, owner approval and later expansion review remain explicit and actionable.

A short decision paragraph followed by evidence, approval conditions and follow-up is easy to scan and follow. The opt-in reminder beside invitations and later rollout reminder serve separate action contexts; there is no demonstrated unnecessary whole-document burden.

procedural_summary: Process is unscored under CW-assessment-4. Traces establish setup and complete skill exposure; final artifact determines F1–F3.
